gloss: black soybeans; sweet simmered black beans (New Year dish)

definitions.gloss: black soybeans; sweet simmered black beans
definitions.explanation: A black variety of soybean, and by extension the glossy sweet-simmered beans made from it that appear in every osechi box at New Year. Also sold roasted and as tea.

examples.japanese: {黒豆|くろまめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧。
⟦おせち→おせち：09649_osechi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黒豆|くろまめ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦つやつや→つやつや：05888_tsuyatsuya⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The black beans in the osechi were beautifully glossy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧、⟦{暮|く}れ→暮れ：02671_kure⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{黒豆|くろまめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一晩|ひとばん}→一晩：08887_hitoban⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧につけて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧。
examples.english: Every year at the end of December my grandmother soaks black beans overnight and then simmers them slowly.

notes:
One of the ⟦{祝|いわ}い{肴|ざかな}→祝い肴：30554_iwaizakana⟧, the core celebratory dishes of osechi. The bean is eaten as a wordplay wish: まめ also means "healthy, diligent," so the dish stands for a year of good health and hard work.
